title: Revelations & Epiphanies — Derived Insight Index
status: canonical index for derived insight waves
purpose: Provide a home for higher-order discoveries produced by rereading older conversations through the mature archive. Insights are distinct from primary Tim canon, ordinary chronology, Works and empirical findings.
rules: Every insight must cite or name its older clues.
Never backdate a derived epiphany into Tim's earlier beliefs without primary evidence.
Prefer insights that connect multiple existing branches and reduce explanatory complexity.
Record what would weaken or falsify the insight where possible.
Keep supernatural, symbolic, historical and systems interpretations in distinct evidence classes.
future_wave_method: skim old conversations → recover exact motif → locate current branches → identify surprising cross-branch relation → test against chronology/provenance → promote only if explanatory compression is high
